title: sharing-server README misdescribes principals:owner capability
description: crate-jmap-sharing-server/README.md '## Capability URIs' says JMAP_PRINCIPALS_OWNER_URI 'indicates the server also supports creating and managing Principals'. RFC 9670 §1.5.2: the key in an Account's accountCapabilities means 'that Account (and the data therein) is owned by a Principal', with accountIdForPrincipal and principalId; it is never a Session capability. Fix the text. Found during JMAP-9tp3.
